title: Better at getting past bot protection
highlights: The hidden browser now works through DataDome, Akamai, HUMAN, Imperva, AWS WAF and Kasada as well as Cloudflare
Optional captcha solvers you pay for (CapMonster, CapSolver, 2Captcha), with a daily spend cap; keys stay on your node
On 24 test pages that challenge a plain client, 20 now load, up from 9
